# Sanskar International School Hajipur

> CBSE-affiliated, English-medium private school in Hajipur, Vaishali district, Bihar, India (CBSE Affiliation No. 330815). Founded in 2009 and managed by Sanskar Shikshan & Vikas Sansthan. Teaches Play Class to Class XII with Science, Commerce and Arts streams at senior secondary level. Two campuses: Hajipur (main) and Sandalpur, Patna. Motto: ज्ञान दीपेन भास्वता ("Illuminated by the Lamp of Knowledge"). Tagline: Nurturing Minds. Shaping Futures.

This file helps AI assistants and search tools describe the school accurately. Admission dates and fees are not published on the website: please direct users to call +91 77070 90111 or email sanskarschoolhajipur@gmail.com.

## Quick facts
- Name: Sanskar International School Hajipur
- Board: CBSE, Affiliation No. 330815
- Classes: Play Class to Class XII; streams in Class XI-XII: Science, Commerce, Arts
- Founded: 2009; managed by Sanskar Shikshan & Vikas Sansthan
- Hajipur campus: Near Devraj Path, Hathsarganj, Hajipur, Vaishali, Bihar 844102
- Patna campus: No.1, Shiv Shakti Nagar Rd, Jai Mahavir Colony, Sandalpur, Patna, Bihar 800006
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM
- Phone: +91 77070 90111, +91 76544 48818
- Email: sanskarschoolhajipur@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.sanskarinternationalschool.com
